title: Tom and the Hog
lines: Tom has a hog. The hog is not big.
The hog naps in a hot bog.
Tom got a mop and a pot.
Tom can not mop the hog.
The hog hops on a log.
The log tips. The hog is in the bog!
Tom is not mad. Tom hops in.
Tom tugs and tugs. The hog got up.
Tom got the mop. The hog is not hot.
The hog naps on a cot. Tom naps.

questions.ask: What did Tom get to clean the hog?
questions.listenFor: A mop and a pot. If they name only one, ask "what else?" and let them look back at the line.

questions.ask: How did the hog end up in the bog the second time?
questions.listenFor: The hog hopped on a log and the log tipped. Have them find the line with the word log in it and read it back.

questions.ask: Do you think Tom likes his hog? Tell me why you think so.
questions.listenFor: No wrong answer here. Listen for a reason from the story - Tom hopped in after him, or Tom was not mad. The reason is what you are listening for.
